title: Apply current prices and catalogue rules at shop checkout
description: Shop checkout now reads current product prices when the payment is started, so a catalogue or price-list change made since an item was added to the cart is reflected both in the amount charged and on the resulting order. Checkout also applies the same catalogue rules as the product pages: an item that is no longer available, one the shop is configured not to sell while out of stock, or one that does not belong to the workspace's own catalogue now stops the checkout instead of being ordered. Cart quantities are accepted as whole positive numbers.
